title: Merry Christmas And Happy Winter Holidays 2024-2025!
html:
Another end of a year is around the corner, one that continued to challenge the world more than expected. Let’s hope again for the good and peace everywhere!

Relying on the friendly and collaborative community, Kamailio project continued with a significant development and evolution, getting out another major release series, 5.8.x, and several minor releases in branches 5.6 and 5.7.

Moreover, the next major release series 6.0.x is already baking, currently being in the testing phase, development being frozen about a week ago. Expect to be out during the second part of January 2025, latest during the first part of February 2025.

Merry Christmas and Happy Winter Holidays!

Santa is flying Kamailio!
